provenance: synthetic fixture for tests and smoke runs

tools.name: list_issues
tools.description: List issues in a repository. Use this when you need multiple issues; do not use it to fetch a single known issue.

tools.name: get_issue
tools.description: Get a single issue by number. Use this when you already know the issue number.

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create an issue. Do not use this to comment on an existing issue.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search code across repositories. Use when you need to locate symbols; prefer get_file when you know the path.
